news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is out now
news.summary: Take-Two announced that Grand Theft Auto VI is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, launching as the highest rated game of all time.

news.title: 17 verified GTA 6 cheat codes added
news.summary: Vice Codes Hub's GTA 6 cheats page was last updated on November 18, 2026. This feed includes 17 GTA 6 codes verified by at least two of PC Gamer, GameSpot and PowerPyx. Cheats do nothing until you finish all 91 story missions. Press Up for the phone, hold L1/LB, press R1/RB, then enter the D-pad input. Using a cheat disables saving and trophies for that session.

news.title: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on PS5 and Xbox
news.summary: Rockstar's support site says Grand Theft Auto VI will release at midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions for both PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Xbox Cloud Gaming streaming starts at 1 a.m. ET on November 19.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI streams on Xbox Cloud Gaming from 1 AM ET on November 19
news.summary: Xbox Wire says GTA VI is playable day one through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S from 1 AM ET, using Xbox Series S settings; the game must be purchased separately.

news.title: Pre-load is live on PS5 and Xbox
news.summary: Rockstar's Newswire says pre-loading is now available for everyone who pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI digitally; code-in-box buyers can redeem their code and pre-load as soon as they have it. The download needs up to 212 GB. The game unlocks November 19, 2026.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami on November 21
news.summary: Rockstar and PlayStation announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival on Saturday, November 21, 2026 at Mana Wynwood in Miami, with two stages of artists from the game and its soundtrack. Tickets are sold to lottery winners; the event is 17+.

news.title: Take-Two Q2 FY2027 earnings call set for November 9
news.summary: Take-Two Interactive reports second-quarter fiscal 2027 results on Monday, November 9, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30 PM Eastern. The quarter ended September 30, so results will not include post-launch Grand Theft Auto VI sales. It is the last scheduled investor call before the November 19 launch.

news.title: Rockstar opens The Launch Gallery with new GTA VI screenshots
news.summary: On November 5, 2026, Rockstar opened The Launch Gallery on the official Grand Theft Auto VI site with a collection of new marketing screenshots of Vice City, Jason, Lucia, Grassrivers, the Leonida Keys and Port Gellhorn. Launch remains November 19, 2026. This is imagery, not a systems update.

news.title: Pre-load moves up to November 10; up to 212 GB
news.summary: Rockstar's Newswire says digital pre-loading starts November 10, 2026: at midnight local time on PlayStation 5 and at 12 a.m. GMT worldwide on Xbox Series X|S. Code-in-box copies arrive at retailers from November 12. The pre-load file needs up to 212 GB depending on the console. Launch is still November 19, 2026.

news.title: Pre-orders and pricing announced
news.summary: Take-Two announced Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders for a November 19, 2026 launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard Edition is $79.99 and Ultimate Edition is $99.99. Digital pre-orders can pre-load starting November 12, 2026. Physical copies include a download code and go on sale that same day. Update: on November 3, 2026, Rockstar moved digital pre-loading up to November 10; boxed copies still arrive November 12.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI set for November 19, 2026
news.summary: Rockstar's Newswire says Grand Theft Auto VI will now release on Thursday, November 19, 2026.

Pre-load opened November 10; if you skipped it, the full download needs up to 212 GB
